title: Erlang ETS read-through cache
context: Read-through cache in front of a slow pricing service. get/3 returns the cached value while it is younger than TtlMs milliseconds, otherwise it calls Loader() and caches the result. Loader errors ({error, _}) must be returned to the caller but never cached. The table is owned by the cache gen_server so it survives caller crashes.
code: [{Key, Value, StoredAt}] when Now - StoredAt > TtlMs ->

expected.why: the age test is inverted: entries older than the TTL are served and fresh ones are reloaded
the timestamp is stored in seconds but compared with millisecond time, so every age computation is wrong
{error, _} results from Loader are cached and served as values until they expire
